selection: First tier: support-first among metric_app.mrt values by opaque tc identity, requiring at least minimum_support_per_window finite unique timestamps in both windows; ties use canonical tc ID. If unsupported, report no selected primary KPI. No CPU/memory fallback is allowed.
unit_policy: mrt is a working mean-response-time-style interpretation from its name; absolute units remain undeclared. The tc value is an opaque application KPI identity and is never mapped to a component.
selection_provenance: Reconstructed fixed Bank development rule; the upstream Bank query is window-only and does not specify a KPI.
